title: Santa-hat bat ornament
subtitle: Traced from your wall photo · 50 mm wingspan · black base with the red hat and white trim on top · hangs from a tiny hole in the wing, shown as it hangs · millimetres
scale_note: Real size: 50 mm wing tip to wing tip (your pick). It hangs tilted, so its overall box is 29 × 52 mm. The photo looks along the wall, so the bat appeared squashed sideways; it's stretched 1.23× to undo that (estimated from the round pom-pom).
notes_title: v5: what changed, what to check
notes: v5: no ring. The ornament hangs from a tiny 1.8 mm hole in the black upper wing, black on black so it nearly disappears. The hat sits right over the balance point, so a hole in the black can't hang level: the bat hangs tilted about 43°, diving (your pick over a hole in the brim or a glued thread). The view shows it as it really hangs. The pom-pom is a solid 4 mm white ball again. Everything else is as in v4: a black 2 mm base with the red and white layered on top (~5 colour swaps). Check: the diving angle, and that 1.8 mm takes your thread or hook (fishing line or a thin wire hook works best).
